authority.alpha_prerequisite: C-06h must attack the accepted C-06g rrflowKV projected reader and existing WAL/MVCC/manifest/compaction paths with a replayable independent model, deterministic fault schedules, mixed-family histories, cancellation and resource cases, and real coverage-guided fuzz targets before physical-policy selection or DataFusion integration can rely on that storage stream.

current_behavior: C-06g provides a synchronous bounded ProjectedReadStream over one pinned sequence, manifest, memtable generation, and eligible immutable segments. Four fixed generated histories and focused tests cover projection, ranges, budgets, tombstones, equal-sequence rejection, cancellation, one generation/GC interleaving, and deterministic malformed segment bytes. Existing failure_matrix tests exercise each write, flush, and compaction fail point separately. The repository has no reusable operation-sequence oracle shared by ordinary tests, a stress executable, and a fuzzer; no coverage-guided fuzz project or retained corpus; and no single generated history combines semantic-family batches, snapshots, projected reads, reopen, fault injection, compaction, garbage collection, cancellation, and resource denial. The active toolchain initially had neither cargo-fuzz nor a nightly fuzz toolchain. The baseline generated mixed-family characterization passes one test, while cargo fuzz was unavailable before the qualification tool was installed outside the repository. The release-version checker also classifies every Cargo.toml below crates as a product package, so it rejects the correctly isolated nested cargo-fuzz workspace instead of validating that workspace as development-only tooling.
target_behavior: rrd-lsm gains one test-only deterministic state-machine model that maps arbitrary bytes or a seed to bounded valid operation histories over realistic record, inbound/outbound graph, scalar, term, vector, runtime, and evidence key families. An independent MVCC oracle verifies point, broad range, disjoint range, key-only projected, and key-value projected reads at retained snapshots while operations interleave atomic multi-family writes, deletes, flush, reopen, protected compaction, garbage collection, pinned reads, cancellation/drop, every injected write/flush/compaction boundary, and deliberate resource exhaustion. A normal integration suite replays fixed seeds and emits the exact failing seed/input; an rrflowkv_stress example runs configurable seed/case/operation counts and reports stable counters; a nested locked cargo-fuzz project reuses the same state machine and mutates the authenticated segment-v4 fixture in separate AddressSanitizer-enabled targets. Fuzzer artifacts remain ignored, corpus seeds remain tracked, and every unexpected error or state difference fails instead of truncating, retrying, or updating the oracle from implementation output. The version-policy checker recognizes only an explicitly marked cargo-fuzz manifest as nested tooling and separately enforces version 0.0.0, publish=false, a self-contained nested workspace, a fuzz directory below a declared product crate, and exclusion from the product workspace. No product API or new engine authority is added.
unchanged_behavior: RrdEngine remains the sole semantic transaction, authorization, context, reasoning, recall, installation, and lifecycle authority; qualification code cannot mutate that boundary.
rrflowKV remains the one local persistent substrate and rrflowMX remains its volatile semantic-conformance profile; no alternate backend or compatibility reader is introduced.

WAL v1, batch v2, manifest v3, CURRENT publication, application key format RRKV0001, segment v4 bytes, checksums, row-group layout, MVCC visibility, transaction conflicts, snapshots, compaction, garbage collection, and ProjectedReadStream public behavior remain unchanged unless the new corpus proves a defect and a new planning-only repair package authorizes the exact production edit.
The ordinary test, stress, and fuzz drivers use only public rrd-lsm behavior and an independent model; they do not import private merge or recovery implementation as their oracle.

The nested fuzz project is development-only, locked, and not a runtime dependency or shipped prerequisite. The version checker validates that isolation without treating the fuzz package as a release package. Root Cargo.toml, root Cargo.lock, product dependency closure, and version 1.0.0 remain byte-identical.

DataFusion is not added to rrd-lsm. C-06h qualifies the bounded physical source that F-01 will adapt into a stamped polled RecordBatch stream; it does not call the current eager rrflowQL path or claim F-01.
Loom is not used to imply completeness for file-system concurrency it cannot model; Miri is not claimed over mmap, file-system, ring, and sanitizer execution it did not run.

No hook, session-start behavior, provider runtime, model call, external database, mesh, installer, attunement executor, graph/BM25/vector query operator, Connectome path, or primary rrflow binary is added by this qualification package.
C-06 remains open for C-06i measured physical-policy selection; C-07 and Gates D through J remain open, and no alpha outcome or competitive performance claim changes.
No source is copied from RocksDB, FoundationDB, cargo-fuzz, or another reference system. Only their testing behaviors are adapted to RRFlow's existing public operations and failure semantics.

symbols: flush compaction garbage collection and reopen

implementation_changes.action: Add the one reusable test-only state-machine executor and independent MVCC oracle. Decode bounded operation sequences, seed every semantic family, maintain retained snapshots, execute all normal and injected-failure transitions, compare point/range/projected results, assert terminal and lease behavior, and return stable diagnostic counters plus the exact seed/input digest.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Every unexpected storage result, partial family batch, snapshot difference, out-of-order or duplicate projected key, tombstone resurrection, incorrect terminal outcome, leaked read lease, or resource-bound violation panics with the replay coordinate. Expected injected failures are matched by typed boundary/mode and followed by deterministic reopen; implementation output never rewrites the oracle.

implementation_changes.action: Add the normal locked integration suite that replays named fixed seeds and directed operation programs through the shared model, proving mixed-family state, all failure boundary classes, compaction/reopen, projected reads, cancellation/drop, and resource denial without requiring nightly tooling.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: A failing generated history prints the complete seed, case, operation index, operation kind, and input hex/digest needed for exact replay; zero tests or filtered-only execution cannot count as evidence.

implementation_changes.action: Add a configurable developer stress executable over the same oracle with explicit seed, case count, operation count, maximum input, and optional retained root. Print one stable summary only after every case passes so failures remain reproducible and long runs can be scheduled outside unit-test time limits.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Unknown, duplicate, absent, zero, or overflowing arguments fail before storage creation. A scenario failure terminates nonzero and retains its replay coordinate; the runner never retries or labels a partial run successful.

implementation_changes.action: Add a cargo-fuzz nested workspace with exact libfuzzer-sys and development-only rrd-lsm/tempfile dependencies. Keep it outside the product workspace and declare both targets with tests, docs, and benches disabled.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The fuzz project fails dependency resolution or compilation rather than falling back to a different engine, unlocked Git source, or product dependency.

implementation_changes.action: Generate and retain the nested fuzz workspace lockfile so the qualification toolchain resolves the same third-party source graph on replay without changing the product Cargo.lock.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: A lock drift or unavailable dependency fails the fuzz build; no runtime fetch or unpinned Git source is accepted as qualification evidence.

implementation_changes.action: Ignore only fuzz build output, generated corpus growth, coverage, and crash artifacts while retaining the hand-selected seed corpus and source.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: A crash artifact is reported by the fuzz command but never silently staged as product source; tracked seed files remain reviewable.

implementation_changes.action: Document exact nightly/cargo-fuzz prerequisites, target purposes, bounded smoke commands, long-run commands, artifact reproduction, and the distinction between one bounded run and continuous qualification.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The instructions must not imply that absent tools, zero executions, a compile-only run, or an empty corpus passes C-06h.

implementation_changes.action: Add a coverage-guided target that bounds input length and sends each byte program through the same independent state-machine oracle used by ordinary tests and the stress runner.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Any panic, sanitizer finding, timeout, exact-model difference, or unexpected storage error is a failing artifact. Empty and oversized inputs terminate deterministically without allocating or executing unbounded work.

implementation_changes.action: Add a coverage-guided authenticated-format target that decodes the frozen segment-v4 vector, applies bounded truncate/bit/range/magic mutations selected by input, opens the result through the public parser, and permits only a valid segment or a typed error without panic or sanitizer finding.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Malformed input may be rejected by any precise storage error but may not panic, abort outside libFuzzer, read beyond the bounded file, or expose a partially trusted Segment.

implementation_changes.action: Add one small reviewed byte corpus seed that exercises family writes, deletes, projections, flush, compaction, and reopen decoding.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The seed remains bounded and deterministic; corpus expansion is generated fuzz output and is not mistaken for reviewed evidence.

implementation_changes.action: Add one reviewed byte corpus seed emphasizing injected write/flush/compaction failures, cancellation/drop, GC, and resource denial.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The seed's expected failures remain typed and deterministic; it cannot authorize retries or successful truncation.

implementation_changes.action: Add a reviewed mutation directive seed for the frozen segment-v4 byte target.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The directive remains bounded by the target and any parser panic or sanitizer finding is a failure.

implementation_changes.action: Add a reviewed truncation directive seed for the frozen segment-v4 byte target.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: The target truncates only its temporary fixture copy; malformed storage remains isolated and a parser panic or sanitizer finding is a failure.

implementation_changes.action: Separate root product-package discovery from explicitly marked nested cargo-fuzz tooling. Keep exact equality between declared workspace members and product manifests, then validate every excluded fuzz manifest as version 0.0.0, publish=false, a self-contained one-member workspace located at a fuzz directory directly below a declared product crate and absent from root workspace membership.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: An unmarked nested manifest, a fuzz marker on a declared product member, an unexpected nested-workspace shape, a publishable or release-versioned fuzz package, or a fuzz project outside a declared product crate remains a version-policy error. The checker must not broadly ignore manifests below crates.

Add the readable exact code/test/research/replay plan, tool applicability decisions, and handoff to C-06i; it remains subordinate to the roadmap and active JSON.
Link the C-06h readable plan as the active package and retain C-06g as completed supporting evidence.
Record actual C-06h model/stress/fuzz commands and results, retained limitations, and C-06i as the remaining C-06 package without checking C-06 early.
Narrow POAM-002 and POAM-004 only by verified qualification behavior; retain continuous crash, installed-path, physical-policy, and DataFusion gaps.
Document the new ordinary/stress/fuzz qualification surfaces and exact evidence limit without changing segment-v4 or projected-read contracts.
Move only C-06h's adversarial/property/fuzz/fault and mixed-family portion from planned to measured partial evidence; leave C-06 and C-07 open.

Extend the existing deep research artifact with the exact C-06h testing design, retained/rejected practices, tool applicability, and current primary sources; update its implementation audit after proof.

Add the required C-06h execution journal with baseline, complete reads, exact paths, commands/results, first failures, resource/debug decisions, non-runs, and next package. Preserve all historical journals.

research.reason: C-06h defines the qualification mechanism for a persistent storage substrate on which later native graph/index and streamed DataFusion execution will rely. Current primary sources were compared with the existing RRFlow APIs before freezing the implementation. The package adapts testing properties—not foreign formats, public APIs, option surfaces, or source trees.

sources.title: RocksDB Stress Test
sources.retained_behavior: Combine randomized operations and features with independent state validation, deterministic white-box failure boundaries, crash/reopen cycles, and sanitizer lanes; preserve the failing configuration for replay.
sources.rejected_assumption: A few unit tests, compile success, or copying db_stress's option surface proves RRFlow durability or RocksDB equivalence.

sources.title: FoundationDB Simulation and Testing
sources.retained_behavior: Use deterministic seeds and invariant workloads so a fault schedule can be replayed exactly, while recognizing that simulation must later be complemented by live performance and hardware failure testing.
sources.rejected_assumption: A deterministic single-process model covers operating-system crash, real filesystem, device, timing, or distributed failure behavior.

sources.title: FoundationDB Client Testing
sources.retained_behavior: Exercise normally rare error paths intentionally and retain seed-based replay, rather than waiting for production failures to reach recovery logic.
sources.rejected_assumption: Probabilistic fault injection may be enabled in production or an injected error alone proves state correctness after recovery.

sources.title: Rust Fuzz Book: Structure-Aware Fuzzing
sources.retained_behavior: Feed the fuzzer a valid sequence of storage operations so coverage reaches stateful merge, recovery, cancellation, and compaction behavior instead of stopping at shallow input rejection.
sources.rejected_assumption: Unbounded raw bytes, one retained seed, or target compilation counts as a completed fuzz campaign.

sources.title: cargo-fuzz
sources.retained_behavior: Use libFuzzer coverage guidance, retained corpus/crash artifacts, bounded reproducible smoke commands, and AddressSanitizer in the real target build.
sources.rejected_assumption: cargo-fuzz is a product runtime dependency, substitutes for the stable model suite, or can prove absence of defects after a short bounded run.

sources.title: Loom concurrency permutation testing
sources.retained_behavior: Reserve small-state concurrency permutation testing for code whose synchronization primitives can actually be modeled and state its memory-model limitations.
sources.rejected_assumption: Loom models mmap, filesystem durability, process crashes, io_uring, arbitrary std synchronization, or the full C11 memory model; it is not added merely to create a passing badge.

runtime_trace.reason: No product operation or trace contract changes. The harness exercises existing redacted rrd-lsm tracing and reports replay coordinates; H-05 still owns cross-engine causal traces.

resource_evidence.reason: Scenario reports count operations, writes, injected failures, flushes, compactions, reopens, garbage collections, projected reads, emitted rows/batches, cancellations, and verification passes. Directed cases assert selected-page and request/output/batch bounds; fuzz input and operation counts are capped.

debugging_evidence.reason: Every stable and fuzz run retains exact seed/input digest, case and operation index. libFuzzer owns minimized crash artifacts; the stress executable fails nonzero and prints replay coordinates without logging keys, values, secrets, or host paths.

first_failure_oracle: At the clean baseline, cargo fuzz --help exits 101 because cargo-fuzz is absent, and the repository contains no fuzz target, corpus, or nested fuzz lockfile. The tool is installed outside the repository before implementation, but target listing still fails until the planned fuzz sources exist.

No cargo test target named projected_read_adversarial exists, so the stable operation-sequence suite cannot run and no exact arbitrary history combines mixed-family writes, failure boundaries, reopen, projected reads, protected compaction, cancellation, and resource denial.
No rrflowkv_stress example exists, so a developer cannot execute a configurable long seeded storage-model run or retain one stable replay summary independently of the unit-test case budget.

The baseline version-policy checker rejects any nested crates/**/Cargo.toml before inspecting cargo-fuzz metadata, so adding the required isolated fuzz workspace makes python3 scripts/check_version.py fail even though that tooling must not join the product workspace or use the frozen 1.0.0 release version.

The existing generated_mixed_family_histories_match_model_across_reopen_and_compaction characterization passes one test, establishing behavior to preserve but not the broader C-06h fault/fuzz state space.
edit_sequence: Create the shared independent model and stable integration tests first. Run the smallest fixed-seed case and correct the harness—not the implementation oracle—until its own deterministic invariants and diagnostics are sound.

Add directed all-boundary, cancellation/drop, and resource-limit programs. If they expose a production defect, stop without editing production and replace this plan with an exact repair package rooted at the current planning commit.
Add the configurable rrflowkv_stress example over the same model and run a bounded multi-case workload with an explicit seed and operation count.

Add the locked nested cargo-fuzz workspace, tracked seeds, operation-history target, and authenticated segment-v4 mutation target. Generate only its nested Cargo.lock and keep all generated artifacts ignored.

Update the version-policy checker to distinguish and strictly validate explicit cargo-fuzz tooling from product packages; prove that product workspace parity and frozen 1.0.0 enforcement remain exact.

Build and run both fuzz targets on the installed dated nightly with AddressSanitizer for explicit bounded runs; retain exact runs, corpus counts, tool versions, and any artifact. Do not translate a bounded clean run into an absence-of-bugs claim.
Run the complete rrd-lsm package suite, strict all-target Clippy, frozen-format and architecture guards, locked workspace all-target compilation, and deterministic documentation/inventory checks.

Update only declared evidence with observed commands/results and limitations, regenerate the file plan, reread every changed file and full diff, journal C-06h, commit coherently, resolve the development remote/revision, and push only to rrflow/rrflow-development.
stop_conditions: Any existing or generated planned path is changed outside this exact list, an existing planned file lacks complete baseline review, or a production defect requires an undeclared source edit.
The test oracle derives expected state, sequence visibility, failure recovery, or ordering from rrd-lsm implementation output rather than the operation program and independent model.
A generated history can write outside its temporary root, execute unbounded operations/input/value sizes, use sleep/timing as correctness, retry an unexpected result, or accept partial success.

An acknowledged or recoverable multi-family batch becomes partial, a retained snapshot changes, a tombstone resurrects data, a projected result differs from point/range truth, output is out of order or duplicated, or a cancelled/failed/dropped stream retains a view lease.

A crash/fault boundary cannot be deterministically identified and replayed, a post-fault reopen cannot establish exact expected state, or a fuzz/sanitizer finding is suppressed, deleted, or recorded as success.

The fuzz workspace changes the root Cargo.lock, joins the product workspace, adds a runtime dependency, fetches Git source, requires an external database/service, or becomes part of the signed default runtime closure.

The version checker ignores an unmarked nested Cargo manifest, accepts cargo-fuzz metadata on a declared product package, or permits fuzz tooling that is publishable, release-versioned, outside a declared product crate, or not isolated by its own one-member workspace.

Loom, Miri, fuzzing, sanitizers, continuous stress, cross-platform lifetime, real process crash, ENOSPC, or fixed-hardware coverage would be claimed without the exact corresponding command and evidence.
Segment-v4 bytes, the projected-read contract, WAL/manifest publication, semantic results, version 1.0.0, root dependency closure, or an existing acceptance assertion changes unexpectedly.

Evidence would claim C-06 closure before C-06i, C-07 durability closure, streamed Arrow/DataFusion execution, native graph/BM25/vector/TurboQuant execution, turnkey installation/attunement, persistent reasoning/recall, Connectome readiness, alpha readiness, or RocksDB/competitor superiority.
roadmap_status_change: none; C-06h may be recorded complete only as a subordinate qualification package after every declared stable/stress/fuzz and repository check passes. C-06 remains unchecked until C-06i supplies measured physical-policy evidence.
